data.title: Re-registration fee for summer semester 2027
data.summary: Hochschule Musterstadt confirms your re-registration for winter semester 2026/27 and asks you to pay the €312.40 semester fee by 15 January 2027 to re-register for summer semester 2027. The fee now includes the Deutschlandsemesterticket.
data.explanation: Your re-registration for winter semester 2026/27 is complete. To re-enrol for summer semester 2027, you only need to pay the semester fee (Semesterbeitrag) of €312.40. The money must arrive by 15 January 2027, and the re-registration period starts on 1 December 2026. Use the payment reference exactly as given. If it arrives late, a €15 late fee applies, and without timely re-registration you risk exmatriculation (Exmatrikulation). From summer semester 2027 the Deutschlandsemesterticket is included in the fee. If you have a Deutschlandticket subscription, cancel it in time, by 31 March 2027.

items.title: Pay semester fee for summer semester 2027
items.quote: Der Semesterbeitrag in Höhe von 312,40 € muss bis spätestens zum 15.01.2027 auf dem unten genannten Konto der Hochschule eingegangen sein.
items.action: Transfer the semester fee (Semesterbeitrag) to the university account with the reference 4711123 SoSe 2027; this also counts as your re-registration.
items.consequence: A late fee of €15.00 applies for late payment, and without timely re-registration you risk exmatriculation (Exmatrikulation).

items.title: Re-registration period starts
items.action: You can pay the semester fee from this date.

items.title: Cancel Deutschlandticket subscription if you have one
items.quote: Falls Sie ein Deutschlandticket im Abonnement besitzen, denken Sie bitte daran, dieses rechtzeitig zum 31.03.2027 zu kündigen.
items.action: If you have a Deutschlandticket subscription, cancel it in time to end on 31 March 2027, since the semester ticket will replace it.
items.consequence: You would otherwise pay for two tickets.

key_facts.label: Late fee (Säumnisgebühr)
key_facts.quote: Bei späterem Zahlungseingang wird eine Säumnisgebühr von 15,00 € erhoben.

key_facts.label: Semester ticket validity (gültig)
key_facts.quote: Nach der Urabstimmung der Studierendenschaft ist ab dem Sommersemester 2027 das Deutschlandsemesterticket im Semesterbeitrag enthalten (gültig 01.04.–30.09.2027).
